en.headline: Complaints of nuisance behaviour on public transport hit three-year high
en.dek: The Transport Department and Environmental Protection Department recorded 66 complaints about noise and improper behaviour in 2025, more than double the 2023 figure.
body: Complaints about noisy and inconsiderate passengers on Hong Kong's public transport more than doubled over three years, according to figures released by the government on Wednesday.

The Transport Department and Environmental Protection Department received 66 complaints about noise nuisance and improper or unhygienic behaviour in 2025, up from 31 in 2023. Noise complaints rose from 10 in 2023 to 24 last year, while those about improper conduct such as placing feet on seats rose from 21 to 42.

Secretary for Transport and Logistics Mable Chan said in a written reply to a Legislative Council question that passengers should be considerate and maintain mutual respect. She noted that existing regulations and operators' passenger codes already address such behaviour, with frontline staff guided to advise passengers or refer cases to enforcement when needed.

Chan indicated the government would continue to monitor the situation and work with operators on publicity for etiquette, without committing to new specific offences for loud device use or feet on seats.

zh.headline: 公共交通滋擾行為投訴三年新高
zh.dek: 運輸署及環保署2025年接獲66宗噪音及不當行為投訴，較2023年多一倍以上。
body: 政府周三公布數字顯示，公共交通工具上噪音及不禮貌行為的投訴三年間增加逾一倍。
運輸署及環保署2025年共接獲66宗涉及噪音騷擾及不當或不衞生行為的投訴，較2023年的31宗上升。噪音投訴由2023年的10宗增至去年24宗，涉及踩踏座椅等不當行為的投訴則由21宗增至42宗。
運輸及物流局局長陳美寶書面回覆立法會質詢時表示，乘客使用公共交通服務時應互相尊重。她指現行法例及營辦商的《乘客須知》已有相關規定，前線員工會視情況勸喻或轉交執法部門。
陳美寶表示政府會繼續留意情況，並與營辦商合作宣傳乘車禮儀，但未承諾就大聲播放電子設備或將腳放在座椅上另訂新罪行。
